text: To block a debit card, confirm the last four digits. The block is immediate. A temporary block can be removed in the app.
If a card block fails, quote confirmation code CB-4421 to the support person.
The minimum balance for a savings account is 1000 rupees. Below that, a monthly fee of 50 rupees applies.
Home loan EMI is debited on the 5th of each month. A missed EMI is reported after 3 days.
A complaint needs a product and a one-line reason. A person approves the ticket before it is filed.
डेबिट कार्ड ब्लॉक करने के लिए कार्ड के आखिरी चार अंक बताएं. ब्लॉक तुरंत लग जाता है.
